effect: aucun ralentissement de la progression ; différence de CDR+NACC FTLD-SB à 96 semaines 1,509 (IC 95 % -0,959 à 3,976 ; p = 0,23), aggravation numérique sous traitement ; progranuline plasmatique +164,5 % vs placebo

quote: Both Kaplan-Meier and Cox regression analyses did not reveal significant longer survival in patients carrying rs3173615.

quote: We thus hypothesize that in our case, the allele in the TMEM106B gene, rs3173615 (p.Thr185Ser), might have impacted on the absence of TDP-43 inclusions in the brain tissue expected as result of the GRN mutation.
